instruction: Use command-line automation through the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment and CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\final_benchmark.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\params.json. Create program O2040 in one top-side 3-axis setup with G54 at the part top center, the tool axis along -Z, and 0.5 mm of stock above the part top. Use T1 to face that allowance down to Z0. Use T2 to machine all three 3 mm-deep pockets and the full-depth outside profile. Use T3 to drill through the sixteen standalone D5 holes and the D5 pilot in each of the two counterbores, for eighteen drilled locations total. Use the D8 flat end mill T4 to circle-mill both D10 counterbore recesses to 3 mm depth. Apply the spindle speeds and feeds in tools.csv. Do not use 3D finishing, ball-end finishing, rotary, indexed, or simultaneous 5-axis machining. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-20.nc.
